fusions.name: Split Bat
fusions.desc: Flings half a brick that deals 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Both Ways Out
fusions.desc: Swings the trowel both ways, sending 2 clods of spoil out spread wide; each deals 11 damage and knocks the enemy it hits back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Diverted Blow
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Either Side of It
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow aimed at you that would have landed is rolled for dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
